headline: Regeneron Secures $270 Million US Ebola Treatment Order
summary: US pharmaceutical company Regeneron secured an additional $270 million order from the US government for its Ebola treatment amid spreading infections in Africa.
why: Government procurement contracts for therapeutics provide stable, high-margin revenue streams for biotechnology companies responding to public health emergencies.

impacts.name: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Inc
impacts.why: Securing a major multi-million dollar government supply contract boosts projected near-term revenues for the biotechnology firm.
